notes.title: Battle Support Game version 1.5 update
notes.notes:
To change the game perspective:
Players can use the mouse to move the camera left and right to view the situation behind the battlefield, no longer a single fixed camera.
Enemy minions will appear from the far right of the map
time changed to 15 minutes

Purchase options:
Now the store has been updated with multiple purchase options
Standard, Deluxe and Ultimate.
and game bundles

notes.title: DEMO VERSION ULTIMATE UPDATE
notes.notes: We plan to update the trial version for the last time, which means that there will be no more updates for the trial version. Only the trial version will not allow you to experience the area war mode and will not have purchase rewards. The area war mode must be purchased after purchasing the genuine version. to play.
